paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with Tunable TM_020 mode
notes: Cavity haloscope search using tunable TM020 mode, mass range 21.38-21.79 ueV (5.17-5.27 GHz). Limit reported as g_agamma > 12.0 x g_KSVZ (90% CL), approximately 10^-13 GeV^-1. KSVZ coupling at ~21.6 ueV is ~8e-15 GeV^-1, so 12x ~ 1e-13 GeV^-1. Exact per-frequency values not tabulated in text; data points are approximate from abstract/text statement. Local DM density assumed rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3. | Vision: Main result ('This work') is in the inset spanning ~21.4-21.8 ueV. The exclusion is given as ratio g_agamma/g_agamma^KSVZ ~ 10-25. With KSVZ ~6e-15 GeV^-1 at this mass, the limit is approximately ~1e-13 GeV^-1. Data points reconstructed from inset which shows red filled region; coupling values estimated from ratio times KSVZ value. Mass range narrow so few distinct points. | Calibration: Benchmark KSVZ consistent (ratio=1.38) | No calibration needed
